title: hourchd worker protocol, v1
description: Messages on the websocket from GET /v1/worker/connect (see docs/DESIGN-hourchd.md, Worker protocol). Each websocket text frame is one JSON object with `type` and `v`. Durations are integer seconds in fields named `*_seconds`. Job and run ids are ULIDs. Unknown fields are rejected within a version; incompatible changes bump `v`. Direction: W→D worker to hourchd, D→W hourchd to worker.

hello.description: W→D. First message after connect. `worker_id` must equal the name of the worker token. `running_job_id` re-attaches a job still running after a reconnect.

hostname.description: Must equal powermaster's hostname for the host.

welcome.description: D→W. hello accepted. `abandon` names the reported running job when it is no longer leased to this worker; the worker kills it. `last_log_seq` (only when the running job was re-attached) is the highest log `seq` hourchd stored for that attempt; the worker resends chunks after it.

as.description: Destination relative to the work root. Omitted: inputs/<job>/<path>.

assigned_job.description: The job as the worker runs it. `argv` and `env` already have output placeholders substituted.

workdir.description: Relative to the unpacked context. Omitted: the context root.

artifacts.description: Paths to upload after exit 0; a trailing / uploads every file under it.

assign.description: D→W. Run this job. `secrets` holds only the secrets the job names (name → value); the worker exposes them as environment variables. `job_token` is set as HOURCH_JOB_TOKEN in the job's environment. Never logged in full.

accept.description: W→D. The job started. No accept within accept_timeout requeues the job.

heartbeat.description: W→D. Renews the lease (any message does). `job_id` omitted when idle.

log.description: W→D. One chunk of job output (at most logs.chunk_max_bytes). `seq` starts at 1 per attempt and increases by 1; hourchd drops chunks with a seq it already stored. `data` is UTF-8 text; the worker replaces invalid UTF-8 with U+FFFD and redacts secret values.

output.description: W→D. One key=value line from $HOURCH_OUTPUTS, sent after the process exits and before result.

key.description: No dot: `${outputs.<job>.<key>}` takes the key after the last dot.

cancel.description: D→W. Kill the job's process group or container, then send result. Known reasons: timeout, cancelled (operator or run cancel).

result.description: W→D. The job ended and the worker is idle. `error` is set when the worker failed around the process (context fetch, input fetch, artifact upload, start failure, killed on cancel); `exit_code` is then the process exit code or -1 if it never ran.
